p.i:
Hostes perde, licet: sed pietas iubet
Cives parcere civibus.

main_text.head: AD ORNATISS. VIRVM D. Iac. LECTIVM IVRISCONS. & Senatorem reipub. Genevensis clarissimum.

p.i:
MVsis amico carmina Lectio
Quae pauca tandem mittitAmiculus
Longam salutem nuntiate
Et bene rem gerere & valere.
Ast occupatum si gravioribus
Cernetis illum forte negotiis:
Iustamque causam si clientis
Promovet auxilium petentis.
Si iura tractat, si Senecam mage
Solatur aegrum vulnere fontico,
Plagosa scriptorum quod olim
Turba manu tulit insolente:
Propensiori ne studio precor
Peccate nostri, commoda tempora
Servate, dimisso Senatu
Sive domum redit ociosus,
Coenam libellis sive petit brevem
Servus relictis, tunc vacat arbitror

page.notes: Engraved woodcut ornament between the verse and the title. Initial M is a large decorated letter. Marginal word "Amiculus" in the right margin is set in italic. Some letters in the verse are faint or damaged; readings follow the scan as best possible.
